meta.title: Invitation templates
meta.description: Browse elegant static, animated and video invitation templates for weddings, engagements, birthdays and dinners. Preview with your own names, then send on WhatsApp.

hero.title: Find the card that feels like your celebration
hero.lead: Filter by occasion, style and format, open any card and type your own names to see it come alive.

filters.emptyBody: Try removing one of the filters to see more designs.

preview.editHint: Type your own details and the card updates instantly.
preview.headline: Headline
preview.perGuest: plus {price} per guest, VAT added at checkout
preview.ctaNote: You can change everything later in the editor.

meta.title: Pricing
meta.description: Simple pricing for WhatsApp invitations: a flat event fee plus a small fee per guest. No subscription, VAT shown clearly.

hero.title: One flat fee per event, plus a little per guest
hero.lead: No subscription and no surprises. Use the calculator to see your total before you start.

included.title: What is included in every event

design.title: Invitation design
design.body: Pick a template and make it yours with names, colours and Arabic or English text.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp delivery
whatsapp.body: Every guest receives the invitation on WhatsApp with one-tap reply buttons.

rsvp.title: Live RSVP tracking
rsvp.body: See who confirmed, declined or has not replied, in real time.

qr.title: Personal QR tickets
qr.body: Confirmed guests automatically receive their own entry QR code.

reminders.title: Smart reminders
reminders.body: Friendly reminders go out 7 days and 1 day before the event.

checkin.title: Door check-in
checkin.body: Your team scans QR codes at the entrance, even on a phone.

privacy.title: Privacy built in
privacy.body: Guests can opt out at any time and you can erase their data in one tap.

compare.title: Classic or animated?
compare.note: Prices exclude {vat}% VAT, which is shown at checkout. Billing starts from {min} guests.

planners.title: Planning events for clients?
planners.body: Planner accounts manage many events and client lists in one place. The same simple pricing applies to every event, with no seat fees.

cta.title: Ready when you are
cta.body: Create your first invitation in a few minutes.
